title: C. Mahmoud and Ehab and the xor

legend: Mahmoud and Ehab are on the third stage of their adventures now. As you know, Dr. Evil likes sets. This time he won't show them any set from his large collection, but will ask them to create a new set to replenish his beautiful collection of sets.

Dr. Evil has his favorite evil integer x. He asks Mahmoud and Ehab to find a set of n distinct non-negative integers such the bitwise-xor sum of the integers in it is exactly x. Dr. Evil doesn't like big numbers, so any number in the set shouldn't be greater than 106.
input: The only line contains two integers n and x (1 ≤ n ≤ 105, 0 ≤ x ≤ 105) — the number of elements in the set and the desired bitwise-xor, respectively.
output: If there is no such set, print "NO" (without quotes).

Otherwise, on the first line print "YES" (without quotes) and on the second line print n distinct integers, denoting the elements in the set is any order. If there are multiple solutions you can print any of them.
note: You can read more about the bitwise-xor operation here: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#XOR

legend.ai: Mahmoud 和 Ehab 现在正在进行他们冒险的第三阶段。众所周知，Dr. Evil 喜欢集合。这一次，他不会向他们展示自己收藏的大量集合中的任何一个，而是会要求他们创建一个新集合，以补充他美丽的集合收藏。
Dr. Evil 有一个最喜欢的邪恶整数 x。他要求 Mahmoud 和 Ehab 找出一个由 n 个互不相同的非负整数组成的集合，使得集合中所有整数的按位异或之和恰好为 x。Dr. Evil 不喜欢大数，因此集合中的任何数都不能大于 10^6。

input.ai: 唯一一行包含两个整数 n 和 x（1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5，0 ≤ x ≤ 10^5），分别表示集合中元素的个数和所要求的按位异或值。

output.ai: 如果不存在这样的集合，输出 "NO"（不含引号）。
否则，第一行输出 "YES"（不含引号），第二行输出 n 个互不相同的整数，表示集合中的元素，顺序任意。如果有多种解，可以输出其中任意一种。

note.ai: 你可以在这里了解更多关于按位异或运算的信息：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#XOR
